name: Continuous Integration

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: ['**']
  push:
    branches: ['**']
    tags: [v*]

env:
  GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build and Test
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest]
        scala: [2.12.21, 2.13.18]
        java: [temurin@8]
        platform: [jvm, js, native]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout current branch (full)
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Java (temurin@8)
        if: matrix.java == 'temurin@8'
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 8
          cache: sbt

      - name: Setup sbt
        uses: sbt/setup-sbt@v1

      - run: sudo apt install clang libunwind-dev libgc-dev libre2-dev

      - name: Check that workflows are up to date
        run: sbt '++ ${{ matrix.scala }}; githubWorkflowCheck'

      - name: Validate JVM
        if: matrix.platform == 'jvm'
        run: sbt '++ ${{ matrix.scala }}; validateJVM'

      - name: Validate JavaScript
        if: matrix.platform == 'js'
        run: sbt '++ ${{ matrix.scala }}; validateJS'

      - name: Validate Scala Native
        if: matrix.platform == 'native'
        run: sbt '++ ${{ matrix.scala }}; validateNative'

  publish:
    name: Publish Artifacts
    needs: [build]
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v'))
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest]
        scala: [2.13.18]
        java: [temurin@8]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout current branch (full)
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Java (temurin@8)
        if: matrix.java == 'temurin@8'
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 8
          cache: sbt

      - name: Setup sbt
        uses: sbt/setup-sbt@v1

      - uses: olafurpg/setup-gpg@v3

      - env:
          PGP_PASSPHRASE: ${{ secrets.PGP_PASSPHRASE }}
          PGP_SECRET: ${{ secrets.PGP_SECRET }}
          SONATYPE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SONATYPE_PASSWORD }}
          SONATYPE_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.SONATYPE_USERNAME }}
        run: sbt ci-release

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
